capabilities: Display the line count of the active note in the status bar
Update the count as you edit or switch files
Customize the label shown after the number
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's status bar does not show a line count for the active note, only other metrics like word count.
summary: Status bar plugin that shows the number of lines in the active Markdown note, with a customizable label after the count.
